propositions: GitHub Actions workflows use inconsistent lowercase or non-descriptive name: field values, making the Actions UI hard to scan.
Two workflow files use .yaml extension instead of ecosystem-standard .yml, creating inconsistency.
eval.yml filename and name: field (prompt-eval) mismatch; file should be renamed to prompt-eval.yml.
eval-plan-review-container.yml is closed scaffolding for story da34 (safe-peg-tuner) and should be deleted.
Workflow name: fields must be rewritten to descriptive Title Case per a standardized naming table, and in-repo references (docs and test files) updated accordingly.
gerrit-verify.yaml and release.yml filenames must remain unchanged due to external dispatch and OIDC trust-publisher constraints.
